title: 23-BCV-005 — Occupancy classification of oil and gas processing buildings

facts.text: The variance applies to low-human-occupancy oil or gas processing buildings outside urban areas and excludes residential, office, warehousing and other non-processing buildings.
The variance permits Group F, Division 2 classification only with a building area not exceeding 150 m² and an Alberta-licensed registered engineering professional’s risk assessment.

The risk assessment includes ventilation rates, gas detection, remote emergency shutdowns, listed fire detection with automatic shutdown/depressurization, and external firefighting water for remote buildings.

The recommendations of the registered engineering professional must be listed in the permit application; CAPP guideline training/procedure measures and specified egress/spatial-separation measures also apply.
The directly linked CAPP guide describes integrated safety management, facility/building design, operations/maintenance and worker competency.
